product.olivetti-quaderno-33.summary: The A5 Quaderno evolution that added Windows and an integrated trackball.
product.olivetti-quaderno-33.history: The Quaderno 33 succeeded the Quaderno in 1993 and kept the A5 format. MCmicrocomputer tested the Windows 3.1 and 60 MB disk configuration priced at 3.4 million lire excluding VAT. The update broadened the tasks that could be carried on a pocket-sized portable.
product.olivetti-quaderno-33.architectur: Clock speed could be adjusted for battery use. The review records a 386SX at 10 or 20 MHz, 4 MB RAM and an auxiliary display showing clock speed and recorder status.
product.olivetti-quaderno-33.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-quaderno-33.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and recording tests are pending.
product.olivetti-quaderno-33.review: Andrea de Prisco, Olivetti Quaderno 33, MCmicrocomputer 131, 1993, pp. 154–159.
